first.rationale: Verify onboarding evidence because completion and activation are both declining and the action may address both drivers of qualified revenue. Verify pricing evidence because the competitive threat makes it a consequential alternative, but its long-term revenue quality and durability must be compared before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines with evidence of durable downstream value. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure to survive the first renewal cycle, which conflicts with the long-term qualified-revenue objective.
